Hook.et: From Middle Low German hôk (“corner, angle”), from Old Saxon hōk, from Proto-West Germanic *hōk, from Proto-Germanic *hōkaz. Compare the sense “small cluster of houses” in cognate Dutch hoek.

Hooliganismus.et: From Hooligan + -ismus, probably after English hooliganism.
